key_insight: ReToken introduces a single learned token that acts like a retrieval query, selecting only the most relevant visual tokens from a large pre-filled cache. This improves vision-language model performance on long-context visual tasks without processing every token at once.
problem_solved: Vision-language models struggle when visual inputs contain many distractors or long sequences, and full-token processing is too expensive for GPU memory. The paper addresses the need for efficient, query-focused visual retrieval from large visual contexts.
method: Train one learnable embedding to serve as an explicit retrieval target for visual token selection.
Use this token to retrieve a sparse subset of query-relevant tokens from a pre-filled visual KV cache.
Train on a small image-QA dataset and apply the method to improve image and video retrieval/understanding tasks.
impact: ReToken makes long-context vision-language inference more efficient and more accurate by focusing computation on what matters most. For practitioners, this offers a practical way to scale visual retrieval under memory constraints while improving robustness to distractors.
